title: Putt Club
tagline: Mini-golf for 2–8 friends at once: three diorama courses, real ball physics and twelve power-ups to ruin each other's putts.

roles.name: Golfer
roles.description: Create a room and share the 4-letter code (or the link/QR), or join one. Everyone plays each hole at the same time on their own device.

multiplayer.notes: Online rooms run on the game's own Socket.io server (server/index.mjs, loaded by npm start). It simulates every ball and decides every score; clients only send aim and power. Solo practice with bots works offline.
